questions.qtext: Which one of the following statement is incorrect regarding a four-jaw chuck?

options.text: Jaws can be moved in their slots independent of each other.
Any irregular surface could be effectively centered.
It is generally used for heavy workpieces.
Less time is spent in fixturing a component in a 4-jaw chuck compared to a three-jaw chuck.

questions.solution:
(d)
The independent jaw chuck (four-jaw chuck), jaws can be moved in their slots independently to
each other, thus clamping any type of configuration. Since, each of these jaws could move
independently, any irregular surface could be effectively centered. Better accuracy in location
could be maintained. However, more time is spent in fixturing a component in a 4-jaw chuck
compared to the 3-jaw chuck. This is generally used for heavy workpieces and for any configuration.
